items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I had a friend there that, a very good friend of mine that was a sergeant, plain clothes detective... His name was Harry.

ctx.x: (Inaudible) another hour at the RKO. I had a friend there that, a very good friend of mine that was a sergeant, plain clothes detective, and everybody thought we was brothers. His name was Harry. And the day that I brought him up to the theater, I told (inaudible). So we met up in Hamp's dressing room, and I had (inaudible) my notice before him as a witness. I didn't want any tricks, you know, played on me.
